observations: Multiple car headlamps wrapped in clear plastic film.
The internal design features a projector lens and a prominent LED light strip.
The units are stored in a pile on the ground.
A small white label is visible on the lower housing of one unit in photo 0, but the text is illegible.
The shape and internal components are consistent with Mercedes-Benz GLA-Class (X156) facelift lighting.
